article.story: BOZEMAN, Mont. -- — Jeremiah Davis had 17 points in Montana State’s 83-70 win over Long Beach State on Saturday. Davis also contributed 10 rebounds for the Bobcats (1-1). Jed Miller shot 5 for 10, including 4 for 8 from beyond the arc to add 14 points. Christian King went 5 of 8 from the field (2 for 4 from 3-point range) to finish with 12 points. Jack Payne led the way for the Beach (0-2) with 17 points and two steals. Jaden Tengan added 15 points for Long Beach State. Yohann Sissoko also had 14 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
